topic: A quotation built, sent, and accepted in the same afternoon — what that pipeline looks like in SmartPRO Hub
format: Build a tight case study: type of company, the problem they had, what changed, the one number that proves it worked
post:
11 out of 14 quotes went cold last month. Not because of price. Because nobody followed up.

Clients said they never heard back. The quotes were sent. The deals weren't closed.

The problem wasn't pricing — it was everything that happens after you hit send. Chasing over WhatsApp. Digging through inboxes. Dropping the ball entirely.

So they moved their pipeline into SmartPRO Hub. Built the quote inside the CRM, sent it in one click. The client signed via e-signature that same afternoon.

No back-and-forth. No printed PDF. No "let me check with my team."

That deal became a repeatable process. Every quote has a status now. Every follow-up is logged. Accepted deals move straight to invoicing without anyone manually pushing them along.

The number that actually mattered: average quote-to-acceptance time dropped from 6 days to same-day on deals where the client had portal access.

One system — CRM, client portal, e-signature, invoicing — instead of four apps and a WhatsApp thread held together with hope.

SmartPRO Hub starts at OMR 12/month. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
